items.exact_assumptions: Finite d. A CPTP map B:M_d->M_d tensor M_d has both marginals equal to a unital, trace-preserving, Hilbert-Schmidt-self-adjoint CPTP map Phi.
items.literature_input: For a permutation-invariant N-output broadcast channel E, Chiribella Theorem 2.2 gives an EB one-site marginal Psi with diamond distance at most 2 d^2/N.
items.derived_statement: For N=2^m leaves formed by a symmetrized depth-m binary B tree, there is an EB CPTP Psi_m such that, for every Hermitian A, tau[A(I-Psi_m)(A)] <= m tau[A(I-Phi)(A)] + 2 d^(5/2) 2^(-m) tau(A^2).
items.resource_model: N-1 calls to B for one tree, an output permutation twirl, and a collective de Finetti measurement. The cited source gives no polynomial gate compilation for that measurement from a rational Choi description.
items.decisive_gap: The loss coefficient m grows as log(d/delta); Psi_m approximates Phi^m, and exact bistochasticity, HS self-adjointness, canonical tracial barycenter, and polynomial implementation are not guaranteed by the source theorem.

items.exact_assumptions: Finite-dimensional channel with an explicitly available complementary channel/Stinespring representation.
items.literature_input: Sutter-Scholz-Winter-Renner Definition 3.7 and Proposition 3.6 characterize and SDP-optimize diamond distance to antidegradability.
items.decisive_gap: For an exactly self-compatible supplied Phi the antidegradability residual is zero; this SDP provides no EB channel and no HS Dirichlet-form comparison.

items.exact_assumptions: Jeronimo-Wu-Xu Theorem 6.1 assumes the full N-site state is supported on Sym^N(C^d); their Theorem 1.2 instead covers arbitrary permutation-invariant N-site states but in trace distance with O(d/N) error.
items.literature_input: Theorem 6.1 gives a dimension-free HS approximation to a two-site Hartree mixture with error at most 8/sqrt(N-1), and Theorem B.6 proves this rate is optimal when dimension grows. The authors state that symmetric purification does not transfer this HS bound to arbitrary exchangeable states because partial trace need not contract HS norm.
items.decisive_gap: The broadcast-tree output is permutation-invariant, not known to be supported on the symmetric subspace; its Choi state also has a retained reference system. No stated theorem converts this state approximation to a canonical EB channel with exact Choi marginals and the required deficit order.

items.exact_assumptions: Qubit depolarizing channel Phi_lambda(X)=lambda X+(1-lambda)tr(X)I/2 with lambda=2/3; it is bistochastic, HS-self-adjoint, and antidegradable/self-compatible.
items.derived_obstruction: Its normalized Choi state has maximally-entangled overlap 3/4, while every separable state has overlap at most 1/2. Hence every EB channel Psi has diamond distance at least 1/4 from Phi_lambda.
items.decisive_scope: This blocks deriving small diamond-norm EB approximation from self-compatibility alone, but it does not refute the target deficit inequality, which allows loss where I-Phi has a spectral gap.
